name: SPF ELECTRIC
old_description: A Leading Provider of Electrical Materials for Manufacturers, Installers & Contractors.
about:
SPF Electric, LLC operates from Angleton, Texas, where it has served the electrical power sector for over 25 years. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders.

The shop specializes in electrical system fabrication, including bus bar fabrication (precision cutting, bending, punching, and shearing of copper and aluminum, plus aluminum bus bar welding), switchgear fabrication, G10/GP03 glass-epoxy components such as barriers and bus supports, relay panels, switchgear doors, and powder coating. All work is performed in-house using CNC cutting, vertical and horizontal press brakes, an iron worker, welding and stud welding equipment. The team also provides reverse engineering, CAD design, drafting, gasket installation, and hardware assembly, and has reverse engineered hundreds of doors, panels, and covers for switchgear, motor control centers, and transformers.

SPF Electric serves industrial, petrochemical, and electrical testing markets, as well as manufacturers, installers, and contractors who need custom electrical components. Typical projects involve switchgear, motor control centers, and transformers for facilities along the Texas Gulf Coast.

The company emphasizes that keeping every service under one roof enables faster turnarounds—quotes within three to five days, rush jobs in one to two weeks, and normal orders in four to six weeks—while maintaining quality through its CAD library of factory drawings for relays, switches, latches, and other accessories.
